title: X9C-5 Service Refactor Pilot 2 Selection
selection_rationale: No safe pilot available for X9C-5. Both remaining service blockers (stage.ts and owner-dashboard.service.ts) are blocked on X9D (Governance Design) Phase. Refactoring either would introduce technical debt without governance clarity.

evidence: stage.ts: No visible route callers (scope unclear) + modifies engagement.isBlocked (governance state)
owner-dashboard.service.ts: 6 service dependencies all governance-aware + will change during X9D

hard_constraints_failures.reason: Both services are governance-dependent. stage.ts modifies engagement.isBlocked state and validates stage transitions. owner-dashboard.service.ts aggregates data from 6 governance-aware services.
stage.ts has no visible route callers in src/app/api. Service-to-service callers are unknown. Cannot determine scope without finding all callers.

excluded_services.reason_excluded: MULTIPLE BLOCKERS: (1) No visible route callers - scope is unclear. (2) Governance dependent - modifies engagement.isBlocked state and validates stage transitions which are critical to intervention phase. (3) Unknown service-to-service dependencies. Cannot refactor safely without understanding full caller graph and governance impact.

GOVERNANCE AND POLICY BLOCKING: (1) Governance dependent - aggregates data from 6 governance-aware services (execution-certainty, execution-drift, decision-confidence, financial-normalization, business-impact, decision-control). (2) Policy dependent - all 6 dependent services are policy-aware and will be affected by governance design changes. (3) Refactoring now would require understanding governance and policy contracts that X9D will define. Better to defer until X9D clarifies.

recommendation.explanation: Both remaining service blockers are blocked on X9D (Governance Design) Phase. Refactoring either would create technical debt because: (1) stage.ts modifications would require understanding how stage transitions affect intervention phase, health status, and re-evaluation. (2) owner-dashboard.service.ts depends on metrics (execution certainty, drift, decision confidence) that will be refined during governance design.
reason_for_deferral: stage.ts is governance-dependent and has unclear callers
owner-dashboard.service.ts depends on governance-aware services that will change during X9D
Governance design will clarify which services are safe to refactor independently
Refactoring without governance clarity creates technical debt

summary.reason: No safe pilot available - both candidates blocked on X9D (Governance Design)
summary.safest_option_if_forced: owner-dashboard.service.ts (smaller scope: 1 function, 1 route caller, read-only)
summary.unsafest_option: stage.ts (larger scope: 6 functions, 0 visible routes, modifies state)
summary.decision: DEFER - Do not implement service refactor pilots until governance design clarifies
